title: Container Bookings: amount and entries of the customer roll fee
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, the customer roll fee is the tier's per-container customer roll fee multiplied by the chargeable containers. It is written as one customer roll fee entry, marked as a customer-requested vessel change, for each roll still owing a fee, and the product is rounded to two decimal places only at the end. Each fee entry carries, as its sailing, the sailing the charged roll moved the booking off, exactly as shown on that roll's entry.

## Calculation order
1. Take the tier's per-container customer roll fee.
2. Multiply it by the chargeable containers.
3. Round the product to two decimal places, once, at the end.
4. Write one entry per roll still owing a fee, each carrying the sailing that roll moved the booking off.

## Worked example (hypothetical)
*Hypothetical per-container fee of 90.00 and 6 chargeable containers, for illustration only:* 90.00 multiplied by 6 is 540.00. With two rolls still owing, two entries of 540.00 are written; the first carries the sailing the earlier of those rolls moved the booking off, the second the sailing the later roll moved it off.

## Wrong reading and correct basis
| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| The entry carries the sailing the booking is now on. | It carries the sailing the charged roll moved the booking off, as shown on that roll's entry. |
| The fee is taken on the full container count in every case. | It is taken on the chargeable containers. |
